title: Jensen Huang and the 'Spy' Story: What We Actually Know #Shorts
description:
What is actually confirmed about the so-called spy in the Jensen Huang story: US Attorney General Todd Blanche said the Justice Department has reached no conclusion on whether the businesswoman was a spy; CNN reported US intelligence officials are divided; Beijing denies it; the criminal probe is about possible export-control violations at Singapore-based Megaspeed and remains open. Nothing has been proven.

- Bernama/Anadolu (AG Blanche, 12 Nov): https://bernama.com/tv/news.php?id=2633618
- CNN via Crypto Briefing (intelligence divided): https://cryptobriefing.com/alice-huang-espionage-investigation/
- AAP via Canberra Times (Beijing denies): https://www.canberratimes.com.au/story/9391332/alice-huang-remains-woman-of-mystery-in-nvidia-scandal/
- CNN via KEYT (DOJ leads Megaspeed probe): https://keyt.com/?p=1501435

Allegations mentioned are reports, not proven facts. Our analysis is labelled as such. News, not financial advice.
